title: The development of plant food processing in the Levant: insights from use-wear analysis of Early Epipalaeolithic ground stone tools
lineage: Research notes paraphrase specified passages; this is not a reproduction.

passages.note: Use-wear and residue analysis of the Ohalo II slab support grinding or pounding non-oily plant materials. The authors consider the evidence for intensive or routine flour production weak and interpret flour production as possibly sporadic.
